verdict.rationale: Otter's AI Chat and meeting summaries generate insights, decisions, action items, sentiment, and follow-ups directly from meeting data (otter-docs-1,3,21,37,34,13), and this is corroborated by a live, OAuth-gated MCP endpoint confirmed via runtime probe (otter-probe-rt-1). missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of insight quality/accuracy (community evidence focuses on privacy/recording concerns, not insight usefulness), and MCP/insight features are Enterprise-gated rather than universally available.
